title: Krispy American Chicken Burger
description: A fatty and crispy American dish featuring gelatine leafs and render-fat, perfect for a post-workout meal, and is dairy-free-friendly
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken breast, gelatine leafs, and render-fat.
Form the mixture into 4 patties and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the patties in the oven for 25 minutes or until they are cooked through.
While the patties are cooking, toast the brioche buns on the oven rack.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of render-fat on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, some lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles, and finally the top bun.
Serve the burgers immediately and enjoy.
Make sure to cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure food safety.
